title: Book One · Chapter 98: The Cupboard Opens Again
story:
School begins again with cold chairs and loud voices.

Everyone has something to tell. Leo rode on a crowded bus. Mei drew a bird. The bird kept moving all the time. Ronan made six bridge feet. He kept two good ones.

Miss Wu listens to three holiday stories. Then she writes the day's reading on the board. They are still doing their ordinary school work. The boat project is just part of the day.

Ronan reads with the child beside him. This child used to tap the ruler. The child reads long words faster. The lines are close together on the page. Ronan finds the right line more quickly.

They share a folded strip of paper. They read one line. The strip lies below it. The strip helps both children find the right line. They can read the same page together.

After lunch, Miss Wu opens the cupboard.

Some class boats changed in the cupboard. One paper boat has a curled side. A wooden strip is loose on another. Ronan and Mei's flat boat has a dry pale mark. The water reached this pale mark.

Ronan touches the mark.

“Can we rub that off?”

Mei looks. “Why?”

“So it looks new.”

“It is not new.”

Mei is not cross when she says it. This time Ronan does not get cross either.

They check the joins first. The boats stay out of the water for now. Miss Wu keeps the loose wooden piece. An adult needs to smooth its rough end first. No one hides it under a fresh layer of paste.

The class book is still unfinished. They have the first pages. They still need to do the final tests. Then they will write about the changes. Miss Wu gives them two weeks for those parts, with other lessons in between.

Leo wants his old group for the final tests. Ronan wants to ask him back. He waits while Leo speaks to his partners.

“We have the string boat,” Leo says afterwards. “I should finish with them.”

Ronan nods. “Can we compare when both are done?”

“Yes.”

Mei changed her mind about purple paint. She wants simple blue lines on all the pages. Then the pages will look right beside each other. “You wanted purple before,” Ronan says.

“I did,” she says. “Now I want this.”

He changed his own mind about other things too. He gives her the blue pencil.

At the end of the day, they return the models to the cupboard. Ronan puts a card in front of theirs: CHECKED TODAY. Mei adds their boat letter. They checked the boat today, so they write that. Next time, they will check the boat again.

Outside, “Why are your hands cold?” Mum asks.

“Cold chairs. Cold water.”

“Warm soup,” she replies.

At home, he puts his folder near his soup bowl. He leaves a clear space between them. Dad points out the careful space.

“Our sea is getting smaller,” Ronan says.

“Perhaps our supper is getting safer.”

He laughs, then reads his new page to them. He stops once at the word cupboard. Dad waits. Ronan looks at the sentence on either side and tries again. At last he says the word and finishes the sentence. He smiles at Dad, then reads on.
studyGuide:
## 重点表达

- cupboard＝柜橱
- curled＝卷曲的
- joins＝接合处
- checked today＝今日已检查

额外情节词（不要求本章全部记住）：paste＝浆糊；firm＝结实；loose＝松脱的。

## 读句提示

**Why are your hands cold?**

你的手／为什么／冷？用完整的直接问句。

## 理解问题

1. 返校后，孩子们先检查模型的什么？
2. Leo为什么决定继续留在原来的小组？
